title: Kayak Explore Cheapest Destinations Scraper
description: Explore Kayak flight destinations from an origin airport with city, country, date window, airline, stops, duration, and fare-search link. Batch origins and set a map area.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Explore Kayak flight destinations by origin and map bounds. Export cities, countries, dates, airlines, stops, and links for choosing flexible trips.
storeCopy.intro: Explore Kayak destinations from origin airports with city, country, departure and return windows, airline, stop count, and flight link. Choose a geographic search area.
useCases: Flexible travelers can discover destinations within a selected map area.
Travel planners can compare candidate cities from several origin airports.
Fare analysts can review dates and airlines for exploratory trip searches.
howToUse: Add an origin airport code to each entry in `origins`.
Set departure and return windows or use the relative date defaults.
Enter northeast and southwest map bounds, then cap saved destinations with `maxResults`.

faqs.question: How do the map bounds work?
faqs.answer: Set northeast and southwest latitude and longitude values to describe the geographic area where destinations should be considered.
